title: Do LLMs Know When They Are Wrong About Molecules? In-Context Property Prediction with Self-Reported Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2610.41745v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are used in many domains, but molecular property prediction with them is still little explored. In this work we evaluate the capability of 7 frontier LLMs to predict molecular properties together with a self-reported uncertainty from in-context examples, and compare them with classical baselines trained on the same molecules. We use 4 datasets and screen each for contamination of the training data of the LLMs: three are clean, and the fourth, ESOL, is memorised by most of the models and serves as a comparison. On the clean datasets every LLM improves with the context, at 30 examples the most accurate one beats every baseline. The requested reasoning effort changes accuracy little. The self-reported uncertainty ranks the prediction errors weakly, with Spearman rank correlations of up to 0.46, about the level reached by the uncertainties of the baselines. translated_title: 大语言模型知道自己何时对分子判断出错吗？基于上下文学习与自报告不确定性的分子性质预测
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已被应用于众多领域，但将其用于分子性质预测仍鲜有探索。在本工作中，我们评估了7个前沿大语言模型基于上下文示例预测分子性质并同时给出自报告不确定性的能力，并将它们与在相同分子上训练的经典基线方法进行比较。我们使用了4个数据集，并对每个数据集进行了大语言模型训练数据污染筛查：其中三个数据集是干净的，第四个数据集ESOL被大多数模型所记忆，可作为对照。在干净的数据集上，每个大语言模型都随着上下文示例的增加而提升性能，在给出30个示例时，表现最准确的模型超越了所有基线方法。所请求的推理努力对预测准确率影响不大。自报告的不确定性对预测误差仅具有较弱的排序能力，其Spearman秩相关系数最高达0.46，大约达到了基线方法不确定性所能达到的水平。结合不确定性与预测结果，在脂溶性数据集上……
tldr: 该研究首次系统评估了7个前沿大语言模型通过上下文学习进行分子性质预测并同时自报告不确定性的能力，发现其在干净数据集上可超越经典基线方法，且其自报告不确定性与预测误差的排序相关性达到与基线不确定性相当的水平。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates 7 frontier LLMs for in-context molecular property prediction with self-reported uncertainty, showing that on clean datasets they can outperform classical baselines, and their self-reported uncertainty ranks prediction errors about as well as the uncertainties from baseline models.
